row: Hi! I am Dr. Kevin Wilkins of Back to Health Chiropractic in Glen Mills, PA. Chiropractic is safe and effective for everyone. Also, being a chiropractor is pretty rad! YouTube has a lot of chiropractors for sure. Some good. Some not so good. I made this channel to show the public what a "normal" day to day chiropractic adjustment looks like. It is incredibly powerful and available to everyone. Like, comment, and subscribe if you enjoy the videos. If you live in the Philadelphia or Delaware areas call or schedule online to become a patient.
